info.name: Siddhi Car Rental Service API
info.description:
All REST APIs of the Siddhi Car Rental backend.

1. Start MySQL and the backend (http://localhost:8080).
2. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Login requests save tokens into the collection variables automatically.
3. To register again, change the `customerEmail` variable.

Demo admin: rutikaparekar@gmail.com / Parekar@123

exec: // Sets pickup/return dates in the future so bookings are always valid
const d = (n) => { const x = new Date(); x.setDate(x.getDate() + n); return x.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };

request.description: Creates a CUSTOMER account and returns a login token. Change customerEmail in the collection variables to register again.
Dates come from the collection variables pickupDate/returnDate (a pre-request script sets them to future dates).
